seed_ledger.name: Texas-Arkansas Power Project (TAPP)
seed_ledger.reason: No data center tie found. NGPL compression-only expansion (about 40,964 HP, up to 400,000 Dth/d, FERC CP26-46, in service Nov 1 2028) under a precedent agreement with Arkansas Electric Cooperative Corporation, to supply gas power plants in northern Texas and Arkansas. The cooperative's 850 to 900 MW Naples, Morris County TX plant is justified by load growth, with a 500 ft lateral. No source names a data center. Compression site is in Arkansas, out of slice. Searches run: 6. Sources checked: Kinder Morgan project page (facts only, no data center); FERC notice via Federal Register (purpose is power for the cooperative); USDA Rural Utilities Service Naples environmental assessment (500 ft lateral, no data center); Talk Business and Power Engineering coverage (cooperative load growth); general trade press (no TAPP data center link); FERC eLibrary docket not opened directly.

evidence.note: NGPL project page: 400,000 Dth/d, compression, power generation in TX and AR, in service Nov 2028
